text: Banca Popolare del Frusinate is a 'Società Cooperativa per Azioni' with its legal seat in Frosinone and share capital of EUR 31,883,700, fully paid up, as at 31 December 2025.
short: Frosinone-based cooperative bank (Società Cooperativa per Azioni); share capital EUR 31,883,700 fully paid up at 31 December 2025.
